items.description: Update personal information, manage passwords, and configure account security with a clean settings interface. Designed for applications that require simple profile management and stronger account protection.

items.name: kanban-application-01
items.title: Kanban Application 01 - Simple Task Board
items.description: Manage tasks across To Do, In Progress, and Done columns with a drag-and-drop Kanban board. Add and remove tasks inline, making it a great starting point for lightweight project trackers and personal task boards.

items.name: kanban-application-02
items.title: Kanban Application 02 - Task Board with Assignees
items.description: Organize tasks across To Do, In Progress, In Review, and Done columns with due dates, assignees, and an add or edit task dialog. Ideal for sprint boards, team workflow tools, and project management dashboards.

items.name: dashboard-shell-01
items.title: Dashboard Shell 01 - Ecommerce Overview
items.description: A complete ecommerce admin dashboard shell with overview tabs, update banner, total sales chart, total assets, orders, profit, advertisement cost, and projects orders sections. Built for ecommerce and retail dashboard applications.

items.name: dashboard-shell-02
items.title: Dashboard Shell 02 - Ecommerce Sales & Analytics
items.description: A full-featured ecommerce dashboard shell with store overview, monthly sales, revenue growth, customer segmentation, order overview, user activity, ecommerce action cards, recent sales, latest products, total assets, and product carousel sections.

items.name: dashboard-shell-03
items.title: Dashboard Shell 03 - Marketing & Traffic Analytics
items.description: A marketing analytics dashboard shell featuring a report banner, key insights, website visits, sales distribution, product action cards, campaign performance, and traffic data sections. Ideal for marketing, SEO, and digital advertising dashboards.

items.name: dashboard-shell-04
items.title: Dashboard Shell 04 - SaaS & AI Dashboard
items.description: A SaaS and AI-focused dashboard shell with a header, metric cards, sales overview, revenue distribution, AI chat assistant, and best AI products sections. Perfect for SaaS platforms, AI tool dashboards, and subscription-based applications.

items.name: dashboard-shell-05
items.title: Dashboard Shell 05 - School & Education Dashboard
items.description: A school and education management dashboard shell with a header, metric cards, attendance overview, grade distribution, fees paid, fees pending, staff salary, recent enrollments, and upcoming events sections. Designed for school management systems and education platforms.

items.name: dashboard-shell-06
items.title: Dashboard Shell 06 - Healthcare & Hospital Dashboard
items.description: A healthcare and hospital management dashboard shell with a header, total patients, monthly revenue, weekly appointments, patient flow, recent patients, doctor performance, department stats, upcoming appointments, and recovery rate sections. Built for hospital management systems and healthcare analytics.
